tr_h_list: When different systems communicate, the system shall facilitate seamless protocol interoperability.
When the number of connected systems exceeds the maximum limit, the system shall handle the excess connections.
When an invalid protocol is used for communication, the system shall reject the connection.
When the system provides documentation, the structure shall be clear and concise.
When the documentation size exceeds the maximum limit, the system shall handle the excess content.
When invalid documentation is provided, the system shall detect the error.
When technology transfer is initiated, the system shall provide accessible documentation and resources.
When the number of requested resources exceeds the available limit, the system shall handle the excess requests.
When an invalid resource is requested, the system shall reject the request.
When RFCs are generated, the system shall use consistent language within a 95% similarity threshold.
The system shall associate a level of compliance and rigor with software class within a 99% accuracy threshold.
When RFCs are generated for high-risk software, the system shall apply a rigorous compliance level within a 100% accuracy threshold.
The system shall use a consistent language style guide for all RFCs within a 90% adoption threshold.
When software is classified, the system shall assign a compliance level within a 95% accuracy threshold.
The system shall provide a language style guide for RFC authors within a 100% availability threshold.
When RFCs are generated, the system shall apply a compliance level based on software class within a 90% accuracy threshold.
The system shall maintain a record of compliance levels for each software class within a 95% accuracy threshold.
When RFCs are generated, the system shall use a consistent formatting style within a 90% similarity threshold.
The system shall provide a compliance level definition for each software class within a 100% availability threshold.
When RFCs are generated, the system shall apply a consistent tone within a 85% similarity threshold.
The system shall maintain a record of RFCs generated for each software class within a 90% accuracy threshold.
When a developer requests candidate requirements, the system shall provide HDTN project requirements within 2 seconds.
When CCSDS reports are generated, the system shall cross-reference RFC sections correctly within 1 minute.
When a developer requests software high level architecture information, the HDTN GUI shall provide the information within 1 second.
When BPv6 protocol test data is requested, the system shall generate test data within 5 minutes.
When a Bundle Protocol functionality request is made, the HDTN API shall support the functionality within 2 seconds.
When a developer requests implementation verification, the Unit Under Test shall verify the implementation within 1 minute.
When a developer requests development process streamlining, the system shall provide streamlined development process information within 2 seconds.
When a formal review of completed draft SRS is requested, the CCSDS shall conduct the review within 1 week.
The system shall ensure that all interface interactions are logged within 1 second.
The system shall ensure that all exceptions are handled within 1 second.
The system shall ensure that all process flows are executed within the expected time constraints.
The system shall ensure that all test requirements are met within the expected time constraints.
When a user enables 'Metafy next character typed', the system shall display the metafied character.
When a user performs tilde expansion on current word, the system shall expand the tilde to the user's home directory.
The system shall install compiled translations within 5 minutes of receiving a valid installation request.
When a user calls the waitpid function, the system shall return the process ID of the child process.
The system shall return the exit status of the last command executed within 1 second of command completion.
When a user sets the value of NAME to selected word, the system shall update the value of NAME.
When a user evaluates a conditional expression EXPRESSION, the system shall return the result of the evaluation.
The system shall define a shell function named FNAME within 2 seconds of receiving a valid definition request.
The system shall provide a clear and concise structure to facilitate easier verification of implementation within 1 week of release.
The system shall enable technology transfer by providing accessible documentation and resources within 2 weeks of release.
